{"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"ns":0,"title":"Stack","missing":true},{"ns":0,"title":"Item Stacks","missing":true},{"pageid":13031,"ns":0,"title":"Inventory","revisions":[{"revid":882981,"parentid":630537,"timestamp":"2021-08-20T16:49:56Z","sha1":"3702d32956d218a30a4a08b64e95919a8c9456be","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"__TOC__ In the Inventory you can check your [[character]]'s [[items]] and [[capacity]]. In the [[Stand-Alone Client]] the Inventory is grouped with the [[Combat Controls]], [[Soul Point]]s, and [[Special Condition]]s. These are separate windows in the [[Flash Client]]. {| | Stand-Alone || Flash |- |[[File:StandAloneInventory.png|150px]]||[[File:FlashInventory.png|180px]] |} == Items == There are 10 square slots to which you can put items for your [[character]]. These are: * on the left from the top to the bottom: ** '''Amulet slot''' - to put an [[Amulets and Necklaces|amulet]] here, ** '''Weapon hand slot''' - to put a [[weapon]] here, ** '''Ring slot''' - to put a [[ring]] here, * in the middle from the top to the bottom: ** '''Head slot''' - to put a [[helmet]] here, ** '''Torso slot''' - to put an [[armor]] here, ** '''Legs slot''' - to put [[legs]] here, ** '''Feet slot''' - to put [[boots]] here, * on the right from the top to the bottom: ** '''Container slot''' - to put a [[container]] (such like [[backpack]] or a [[bag]]) here, ** '''Shield hand slot''' - to put a [[Shields|shield]] here, ** '''Belt slot''' - to put [[ammunition]] or a [[Light Sources|light source]] here. There are also four additional boxes in the four corners around the Inventory in the Flash Client and one box in the top right of the Stand-Alone clients. Presently only one of these boxes is used for the [[Purse]] which can only hold [[Premium Scroll]]s. See above links to learn more about these [[items]] in [[Tibia]]. Since you can only put a weapon at the right hand, and the left hand is just for shields, you cannot put two weapons nor two shields in your hands. Also if you don't have any weapon, you will fight with your [[fist]]s only. In the case of your [[death]] you lose the [[container]] you are carrying and you have a chance of losing any item equipped unless you have full [[Blessings]] or an [[Amulet of Loss]]. You lose all of your items if you die while having a [[Skull_System#Red_Skull|Red]] or [[Skull_System#Black_Skull|Black Skull]], even if you are wearing an [[Amulet of Loss|AoL]] or have full [[Blessings]].
See: [[Death]] for details about dropping items and character deaths. You can access a context menu for any [[item]] in which there are some [[Game Window#Commands|commands]] you can perform. You do this either by right clicking or holding the {{Key Press|Ctrl}} key and right clicking on the item (depending whether '''Tibia Classic Control''' is on or off)
See: section [[Game Window#Commands|Commands]] in [[Game Window]] article for details. {{Client Features}}"}}}]},{"pageid":19550,"ns":0,"title":"Stacking","revisions":[{"revid":1070427,"parentid":471764,"timestamp":"2024-07-16T17:07:56Z","sha1":"4bc768ed38e483525f3e8f58e797ae6cfb916208","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"Stacking is the act of placing multiple [[Character|players]] or [[Creature]]s on a single square by use of a [[Ladder|ladder]], hole, staircase, ramp, or even a congested doorway. After [[Updates/8.53|2009 Autumn´s patch]] it´s possible to stack on a player anywhere on [[Optional PvP]] worlds. To do this you have to walk 2 times within 5 seconds in the tile in which the player is, the first time you will snap-back if you walk for a second time within 5 seconds you will be stacked. There are some restrictions with the stack system: * Area spells will affect all the stack. * Direct attacks (melee, physical damage, non-area runes and attacks such as icicle, fireball, and all the strikes) by default will only affect the one who is at the top of the stack. * The player on the top of the stack will be the one who was first on the tile. * The actions of the top character are not limited. * All the other players in the stack: ** cannot use any attack spell (i.e., area spells, strikes, waves, beams, etc.), ** can use only direct attack runes, but not area or field ones, ** cannot cast [[Mass Healing]] or [[Heal Friend|sio]] another player, but can use [[Ultimate Healing Rune|UHs]] on them and heal with exura, ** can use his/her weapon in hand, ** can use support spells, summon spells, tools like a rope, a melee weapon to break items, make runes, etc. [[Category:Game Terms]] [[Category:Strategies]]"}}}]},{"pageid":74966,"ns":14,"title":"Category:Stackable Items","revisions":[{"revid":627492,"parentid":0,"timestamp":"2015-06-20T05:00:47Z","sha1":"52ba818f1eb4592ade51d90e5f8f23413ed102ee","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"These items can be stacked. To add an item to this category, use: :| stackable = yes [[Category:Items by Attributes]]"}}}]},{"pageid":86013,"ns":0,"title":"Your Supply Stash","revisions":[{"revid":1057911,"parentid":1040648,"timestamp":"2024-04-15T21:30:56Z","sha1":"79c0541bc2a6af5ff38a66a384ed5a102de2a8eb","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"{{Infobox Object|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Your Supply Stash | article = | actualname = your supply stash | itemid = 28750 | objectclass = Utilities | primarytype = Utilities | secondarytype = | tertiarytype = | flavortext = | implemented = 11.80.7048 | volume = | immobile = yes | walkable = yes | pickupable = no | usable = yes | location = Inside every [[Locker (Object)|Locker]]. | notes = The Supply Stash is a special type of container that players can use to store items in [[Depot|Depot Houses]], as an alternative to the regular [[Depot Box|Depot Boxes]]. Only [[Premium Time|Premium]] players can add items to the Supply Stash, but it's still possible to retrieve them after Premium Time runs out. | notes2 =

The Supply Stash has the following characteriscs which distinguish it from the Depot Boxes: * Only items that can be ''stacked'' can be stowed inside it. * The items will be always grouped in a single "stack", regardless of their amount. * Items can be filtered using the same categories used in the [[Market]] and [[Cyclopedia]], as well as searched by name. * Items stowed in the Supply Stash still count towards the [[Depot]] item limit (2,000 for [[Free Account]]s, 15,000 for [[Premium Account]]s) in increments of 100, for example, if you have 100 [[Health Potion]]s in your stash, it would count as 1 item, if you have 101, it would count as 2 items. * When [[Imbuing]], the Astral Sources can be taken directly from the stowed items. * When selling an item in the [[Market]], the Supply Stash has the lowest priority, i.e. items will be first taken from the [[Your Inbox|Inbox]], then from the [[Depot Box]]es and only then from the Supply Stash. * When retrieving items from the Supply Stash, players can select the amount, which will be sent to a container selected in the [[Manage Loot Containers]] dialog or to the main backpack if a specific container isn't selected or free. | history = When introduced in [[Updates/11.80]] the Supply Stash could be filtered by categories (such as [[Creature Products]], [[Decorations]], [[Potions]]) and search by name.
[[File:WU18 Stash Expansion.jpg|300px]]
In [[Winter Update 2018]] another filter for [[Traders]]: [[Esrik]], [[Fadil]], [[Fiona]], [[Gladys]], [[Grizzly Adams]], [[Irmana]], [[Luna]], [[Malunga]], [[Rock In A Hard Place]], [[Talila]], [[Telas]], [[Tothdral]], [[Valindara]], [[Yasir]] was added.
[[File:Supply Stash Interface.jpg|300px]] | status = }}"}}}]}]}}
